🔥 THE PHOENIX WITHIN 🔥
AA Women’s Recovery Meeting

WELCOME TO THE PHOENIX WITHIN

Welcome, Phoenix Sister!

We’re excited to have you join us today and honored to rise in recovery beside you.

📷 CAMERA CHECK-IN REQUIRED

For the safety and security of our members, we ask that you briefly turn on your camera upon entering the meeting for a visual check-in.

This helps us verify that you are in the appropriate meeting — a recovery space for all who identify as women.

MEETING SAFETY

If we cannot complete the visual check-in, or if a participant’s behavior raises safety concerns, they may be removed from the meeting.

Thank you for helping us maintain a safe, respectful, and welcoming recovery space.

Together — Our Stories. Our Power. Our Rising.

🔥 The Phoenix Within AA Women’s Recovery Meeting 🔥

Thank you for helping us maintain a safe, respectful, and welcoming recovery space.

Together — Our Stories. Our Power. Our Rising.
